estimands.observed_feedback: g_t: the advantage the gate learns from. Estimated counterfactual on the firm's believed demand curve with rivals held (gain, lcb), or own realized payoff in a randomized trial minus an action-independent baseline (explore). Contains the firm's misspecification.
estimands.realized_advantage: A_t^realized: the researcher's ex-post fork on the single shock path that occurred, true demand and true costs, horizon H. One draw, so it carries continuation noise.
estimands.conditional_expected_net: A*_t = E[sum_h discount^h (U_h(x*) - U_h(x_B)) | state_t] - adjustment cost, under the declared continuation policy and horizon. Estimated from independent continuations. This is the estimand a gate's prediction is judged against.

continuation_policies.rivals_hold: The evaluated firm holds the action under test; every rival holds its period-t output. Matches the assumption the firm's own counterfactual feedback makes.

regimes.clean: One-period judgement, no delay, no observation noise, no regime shifts: consecutive feedback values do not overlap and nothing is missing.
regimes.overlapping: A judgement window of W > 1 means consecutive decisions' windows share periods, so their feedback values are positively correlated and the standard error understates the uncertainty.
regimes.delayed: Every release is postponed, so the estimate acts on older evidence.
regimes.noisy: Observation noise in what the firm sees when forming its counterfactual.
regimes.missing: Demand-regime shifts invalidate pending judgements, so some decisions never produce any feedback at all. A missing outcome is not a zero gain.
regimes.correlated: High cost volatility makes consecutive judgements share a common drift on top of the overlap, the hardest case for an independence assumption.

variant_notes.per_update_forgetting: The existing rule: statistics decay by lambda once per released value, regardless of how much calendar time passed.
variant_notes.calendar_aging: Statistics decay by lambda^(periods elapsed), so evidence ages with the environment rather than with the arrival count. Equal to the existing rule when releases are one period apart.
variant_notes.change_reset: Per-update forgetting, plus discarding the bin's evidence when a demand-regime change is detected. Sharp but destroys information if the detector fires spuriously.
variant_notes.explore_continuing: Per-update forgetting, plus continuing to randomize with probability `explore_after` even once a bin has been classified decisively, so a changed bin can be re-learned. The propensity and the payoff given up are logged.
